researchBinding.sourceQualityRule: official recruitment and company sources first; official design guidance next; local project evidence and user context remain separately attributed

tiers.label: official public design and accessibility guidance
tiers.use: layout, typography, table, contrast, and readability rules

tiers.label: repository owner documents and current artifacts
tiers.use: project structure, design context, and observed report issues

tiers.label: user-confirmed evidence
tiers.use: personal role, implementation, verification, deployment, and viewpoint

sourceQualityPolicy.selectionRule: Use the highest-authority source that directly supports each claim; keep source authority, applicability, and limitation separate rather than merging them into one confidence score.
sourceQualityPolicy.publicationRule: Retain the detailed source ledger internally; show only the official recruitment posting link in the final PDF unless the user requests broader references.

rules: Use visible table headers and captions or nearby purpose text for comparison tables.
Do not make color the only carrier of score, warning, or confirmation state.
Keep essay body text selectable and searchable; rasterize only explanatory diagrams and charts.
Validate Korean line length, alignment, contrast, spacing, and page overflow after rendering.
Do not claim formal tagged-PDF accessibility conformance without a separate audit.

format.visualAssetPolicy: diagrams, charts, and visual summaries are PNG/JPEG assets; do not expose SVG/XML as final report structure
format.pageMargin: generous consistent margin with constrained reading width
format.cardPolicy: avoid repeated cards; use section rules, prose, tables, and one purposeful callout per page at most

rasterAssets.purpose: quiet editorial cover mark showing connected service flow
company public context to role task to personal evidence to contribution
current essays' four domain interests and their user-facing meaning
high-level project meaning from problem definition to verification and learning
set-level score summary without implying skill reward or hiring prediction
candidate selection, fact check, interview rehearsal, final user decision
